about.lead: My research asks how public institutions decide who is counted, how people are classified, and who is held accountable when those decisions go wrong.
paragraphs: I completed an M.A. in Political Science at Western Illinois University in 2026 with a 4.00 GPA, after a B.S.S. in International Relations at the University of Dhaka. At Western Illinois I worked as a teaching support assistant in the Department of Political Science and as a pre-college instructor in the Rural Postsecondary and Economic Development (RPED) Program.

My interests sit where immigration policy, GovTech, and AI in public administration meet. I work with survey and interview data, comparative case studies, and quantitative tools in R, Python, and SPSS.
I grew up in Bangladesh and now live in Waukegan, Illinois. I speak Bengali, English, Hindi, and Urdu.
